analyzed_vuln.description: Heap use-after-free caused by freeing a partially decoded Variant payload without resetting ownership fields. In Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject, when unwrapping an ExtensionObject as a concrete body type, dst->data is allocated and dst->type is set, then decodeFields() is called. On decode failure, the code does UA_free(dst->data) (line ~2979) instead of UA_delete/UA_clear and does not null dst->data or dst->type. Later UA_decodeJson cleanup calls UA_clear -> Variant_clear -> UA_Array_delete using the stale dst->data pointer and dst->type metadata, causing a second free/read of freed nested members (observed in String_clear/LocalizedText_clear).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered in fuzz_json_decode by JSON that enters Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject (ExtensionObject-in-Variant path), selects a valid/unwrapped body type (TypeId resolves), allocates dst->data, then causes decodeFields of Body to fail after partial initialization. Error path frees raw memory with UA_free but leaves Variant owning pointer intact; subsequent top-level UA_clear on decode failure dereferences/frees the same memory again, producing UAF.
